scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,dist -c blue,green,gray "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run build:watch -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.serve: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npx tsc --noEmit -p client
